newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ business must focus on productivity - Bradford.
newsitem.headline: NZ business must focus on productivity - Bradford.

text.p: Business and farmers should improve their productivity rather than push for a lower New Zealand dollar, Labour Minister Max Bradford said on Monday.

"Business and agriculture, if it is to prosper in the next few years, have to focus, and focus, and focus, on productivity improvement rather than pushing for fallacious panaceas like devaluation of the dollar," he said in a speech to an industrial relations conference.
Bradford said the future of New Zealand's employment law, the Employment Contracts Act, was assured for the next three years at least.
